newsitem.title: USA: Michael Foods completes bank financing.
newsitem.headline: Michael Foods completes bank financing.

text.p: Michael Foods Inc said Friday it closed a new $80.0 million revolving loan agreement with its principal banks.

The credit facility matures in February 2002 and allows the company to borrow at the banks' reference rate or at Eurodollar rates, at its option. Bank of America National Trust and Savings Association is the agent for the facility.
Separately, Michael Foods said it completed a previously announced merger with North Star Universal Inc.

Prior to the merger, North Star held about a 38 percent stake in Michael Foods, an egg, potato and specialty dairy products company. As part of the merger, North Star was renamed Michael Foods and its holdings in Michael Foods were distributed to shareholders.
Also as part of the deal, about 1,782,961 Michael Foods shares were retired out of the 7,354,950 shares held by North Star.
The balance of the Michael Food shares held by North Star were divided by the North Star shares outstanding, resulting in a reverse stock split ratio of 0.562.
The company said North Star shareholders will receive 0.562 share of new Michael Foods common stock for each share of North Star stock held.

In addition, North Star shareholders will receive one share of ENStar Inc for every three shares of North Star held. ENStar's subsidiaries include Americable Inc, which provides connectivity and networking products and services, and Transition Networks Inc, which makes and markets connectivity devices used in local area networks.
ENStar also owns a 23 percent interest in CorVel Corp.
